question: Which of the following is the compound produced by the action of chlorine on dry slaked lime (Ca(OH)2) ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**bleaching powder**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bleaching powder**, chemically known as **calcium oxychloride (Ca(OCl)₂)**, is produced when **chlorine gas** reacts with **dry slaked lime (Ca(OH)₂)**.
 
• The chemical reaction involved is as follows: *Cl₂ + Ca(OH)₂ → Ca(OCl)₂ + H₂O*.
 
• Bleaching powder is a **white or pale yellowish powder** with a strong chlorine smell.
 
• It is commonly used as a **disinfectant**, for **bleaching fabrics**, and as a **sanitizing agent** in water treatment.
